python - <<'PY'
import json
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np

with open('/app/benchmark/source_data.json') as f:
    data = json.load(f)['streaming_rankings']['data']

quarters = [d['quarter'] for d in data]
platforms = [
    'Netflix','Amazon Prime Video','Spotify','Disney+','Apple TV+','HBO Max','YouTube Premium','Hulu'
]

# Business/polished palette
colors = {
    'Netflix':'#1f77b4',
    'Amazon Prime Video':'#2ca02c',
    'Spotify':'#9467bd',
    'Disney+':'#ff7f0e',
    'Apple TV+':'#7f7f7f',
    'HBO Max':'#8c564b',
    'YouTube Premium':'#d62728',
    'Hulu':'#17becf',
}

x = np.arange(len(quarters))
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(20, 11), dpi=160)
fig.patch.set_facecolor('white')
ax.set_facecolor('white')

for p in platforms:
    y = [d.get(p, None) for d in data]
    yy = [np.nan if v is None else v for v in y]
    lw = 3.8 if p == 'Disney+' else (3.6 if p == 'Netflix' else 2.6)
    z = 5 if p in ('Disney+','Netflix') else 3
    ax.plot(x, yy, color=colors[p], linewidth=lw, marker='o', markersize=4.5, label=p, zorder=z)

# axes
ax.set_ylim(8.5, 0.5)
ax.set_yticks(range(1,9))
ax.set_ylabel('Rank Position (1 = Top, 8 = Bottom)', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax.set_xlabel('Quarter', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax.set_xticks(x)
ax.set_xticklabels([q.replace(' ', " '") for q in quarters], rotation=55, ha='right', fontsize=10)
ax.tick_params(axis='y', labelsize=11)

# title/subtitle
ax.set_title('Streaming Platform Rankings (Q1 2019 – Q1 2025)\nBump-Style Trend of Subscriber Rank Position', fontsize=20, fontweight='bold', pad=18)

# grid
ax.grid(axis='y', color='#d9d9d9', linewidth=0.9)
ax.grid(axis='x', color='#efefef', linewidth=0.5, alpha=0.5)

# start/end labels
for p in platforms:
    y = [d.get(p, None) for d in data]
    # start
    si = next((i for i,v in enumerate(y) if v is not None), None)
    if si is not None:
        ax.text(si-0.35, y[si], p, color=colors[p], fontsize=10, va='center', ha='right', fontweight='bold')
    # end
    ei = next((i for i in range(len(y)-1,-1,-1) if y[i] is not None), None)
    if ei is not None:
        ax.text(ei+0.25, y[ei], p, color=colors[p], fontsize=10, va='center', ha='left', fontweight='bold')

# legend
leg = ax.legend(title='Platform', loc='center left', bbox_to_anchor=(1.01, 0.5), frameon=False, fontsize=11)
plt.setp(leg.get_title(), fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')

# emphasize disney ascent
d_vals = [d.get('Disney+', None) for d in data]
launch_i = next(i for i,v in enumerate(d_vals) if v is not None)
peak_i = next(i for i,v in enumerate(d_vals) if v == 3)
ax.annotate('Disney+ rapid ascent', xy=(peak_i, 3), xytext=(peak_i+3.5, 2.1),
            arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color=colors['Disney+'], lw=2),
            fontsize=12, color=colors['Disney+'], fontweight='bold')

ax.annotate('Netflix sustained #1', xy=(12,1), xytext=(14.5,1.5),
            arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color=colors['Netflix'], lw=2),
            fontsize=12, color=colors['Netflix'], fontweight='bold')

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('/app/output/result.png', dpi=160, bbox_inches='tight')
PY
